AllSavings.title: All savings guidance
AllSavings.intro: Plan for everyday surprises and future goals.

sections.title: Start with a goal
sections.text: Give each savings pot a purpose, a target amount and a date. Review your budget to decide what you can put aside.

sections.title: Choose your next step
sections.text: Explore saving habits, compare account features or learn how investing differs from cash savings.

HowtoSave.title: How to save
HowtoSave.intro: Build a savings habit that fits your budget.

sections.title: Make it manageable
sections.text: Choose an amount you can afford after essential bills. A small regular contribution is a useful starting point.

sections.title: Give savings a place
sections.text: Keep money for unexpected costs separate from everyday spending. Review your contributions when your income or bills change.

sections.title: Plan for irregular costs
sections.text: List annual expenses such as insurance renewals and celebrations. Put a little aside each month so they are easier to cover.

TypeofSavings.title: Types of savings
TypeofSavings.intro: Compare access, interest and conditions before choosing an account.

sections.title: Easy-access savings
sections.text: Check how quickly you can withdraw money and whether withdrawals affect the interest rate.

sections.title: Regular and fixed-term accounts
sections.text: Compare monthly deposit limits and withdrawal restrictions. Only commit money for a fixed term if you can manage without it.

sections.title: Saving for a particular goal
sections.text: Match the account to when you need the money. Check current ISA eligibility and tax rules on GOV.UK before applying.

Investing.title: Investing basics
Investing.intro: Understand the risks and costs before committing money.

sections.title: Saving or investing?
sections.text: Cash savings and investments serve different needs. Investments can fall in value and you could get back less than you put in.

sections.title: Understand what you buy
sections.text: Read about the investment, its charges and how you can access your money. Spreading investments can reduce concentration risk but does not prevent losses.

sections.title: Check the provider
sections.text: Use the FCA register and check contact details independently. Take time to understand an offer before sending money.

Allwork.title: All work guidance
Allwork.intro: Explore money matters at each stage of working life.

sections.title: Starting or changing work
sections.text: Review your take-home pay, travel costs and workplace benefits when planning a new job.

sections.title: When circumstances change
sections.text: Use the guides below to prepare for self-employment or a break between jobs.

Employment.title: Employment and your money
Employment.intro: Make sense of your pay and workplace benefits.

sections.title: Read your payslip
sections.text: Compare gross pay, deductions and the amount paid into your account. Ask payroll about anything you do not recognise.

sections.title: Review your benefits
sections.text: Read your contract and check pension, leave and sick-pay arrangements. Include commuting and childcare in your working budget.

sections.title: Keep useful records
sections.text: Store payslips, your contract and tax documents securely. Update your budget when your hours or pay change.

Losingyourjob.title: Losing your job
Losingyourjob.intro: Organise your finances while you plan your next steps.

sections.title: Get the details in writing
sections.text: Ask for confirmation of your final pay, notice arrangements, unused leave and any redundancy offer. Check your circumstances with Acas.

sections.title: Build a short-term budget
sections.text: List available income and essential bills. Contact lenders or service providers early if a payment will be difficult.

sections.title: Find support
sections.text: Check benefits eligibility through GOV.UK and explore job-search support. Keep records of applications and important employment documents.

Selfemploment.title: Self-employment
Selfemploment.intro: Plan for business costs and an income that can change.

sections.title: Separate your records
sections.text: Track invoices, payments and business expenses. Keep receipts and note payment deadlines.

sections.title: Prepare for quieter months
sections.text: Build your household budget around a cautious income estimate. Plan separately for business costs, tax and time away from work.

sections.title: Check your responsibilities
sections.text: Use HMRC guidance to check registration and reporting requirements. Review insurance and pension arrangements as your business develops.

BankingandPayment.title: Banking and payments
BankingandPayment.intro: Choose practical ways to manage everyday money.

sections.title: Compare account features
sections.text: Look at account fees, overdraft costs, access and customer support. Check whether an account meets your day-to-day needs.

sections.title: Keep track of payments
sections.text: Review standing orders, Direct Debits and subscriptions. Leave room in your budget for bills due before your next payday.

sections.title: Protect your account
sections.text: Never share security codes or move money because of an unexpected call. Contact your bank using details you have checked independently.

Budgeting.title: Budgeting
Budgeting.intro: See what comes in, what goes out and what needs adjusting.

sections.title: Gather your figures
sections.text: Use payslips, bills and statements to list income and spending. Include annual costs and irregular expenses.

sections.title: Compare like for like
sections.text: Convert amounts to the same time period before adding them up. Separate essential bills from spending you can adjust.

sections.title: Review regularly
sections.text: Check your plan against actual spending. Update it when income, bills or household circumstances change.

Buyingandrunning.title: Buying and running a car
Buyingandrunning.intro: Look beyond the purchase price when planning a car budget.

sections.title: Count the running costs
sections.text: Include insurance, fuel or charging, servicing, repairs, parking and applicable vehicle taxes.

sections.title: Compare ways to pay
sections.text: Read finance terms, fees, mileage limits and the total repayable amount. Check what happens at the end of the agreement.

sections.title: Prepare before buying
sections.text: Check vehicle history and condition. Keep a reserve for repairs and review insurance costs before committing.

Credit.title: Credit and borrowing
Credit.intro: Understand the commitment before taking on repayments.

sections.title: Compare the full cost
sections.text: Look at interest, fees, repayment dates and the total amount repayable. Check whether the rate can change.

sections.title: Check affordability
sections.text: Consider how repayments fit alongside essentials and existing debts. Think about what would happen if your income fell.

sections.title: Get help early
sections.text: If repayments are becoming difficult, contact the lender and seek free debt guidance through MoneyHelper.

Insurance.title: Insurance
Insurance.intro: Compare protection against the risks that matter to you.

sections.title: Identify the cover you need
sections.text: List existing policies and any cover included through work or other accounts. Check for gaps and overlap.

sections.title: Read the details
sections.text: Compare exclusions, excesses, limits and claim requirements as well as price. Make sure the information you provide is accurate.

sections.title: Review at renewal
sections.text: Check whether your circumstances or possessions have changed. Compare the terms before renewing or switching.

Homess.title: Homes and housing
Homess.intro: Plan for the costs of renting, buying and maintaining a home.

sections.title: Work out a housing budget
sections.text: Include bills, moving costs and ongoing household spending alongside rent or mortgage payments.

sections.title: Explore your options
sections.text: Use the renting and mortgage guides to prepare questions and organise the documents you need.

Mortgage.title: Mortgages and homebuying
Mortgage.intro: Prepare for the upfront and ongoing costs of owning a home.

sections.title: Budget beyond the deposit
sections.text: Allow for legal work, surveys, moving and any applicable property taxes. Include maintenance and insurance in your ongoing plan.

sections.title: Compare mortgage terms
sections.text: Review rates, fees, repayment type and early repayment charges. Consider how a rate change could affect your budget.

sections.title: Ask for help early
sections.text: A mortgage adviser can explain options for your circumstances. If payments become difficult, contact your lender promptly.

Renting.title: Renting a home
Renting.intro: Understand the costs and paperwork before you move.

sections.title: Prepare a moving budget
sections.text: Include rent, any deposit, moving costs and household bills. Confirm what is included in the rent.

sections.title: Read your agreement
sections.text: Check payment dates, repair contacts and notice terms. Tenancy rules vary across the UK, so use guidance for your nation.

sections.title: Keep records
sections.text: Save your agreement, payment records and inventory. Raise maintenance or payment problems promptly and keep written copies.

PensionExplain.title: Pensions explained
PensionExplain.intro: Get to know the pensions you have and how they work.

sections.title: Identify your pensions
sections.text: List workplace and personal pensions alongside your State Pension forecast. Ask providers which type of pension you hold.

sections.title: Read your statements
sections.text: Check contributions, charges and retirement estimates. Estimates are not a guarantee of future income.

ManageandGrow.title: Manage and grow your pension
ManageandGrow.intro: Keep your retirement plans under review.

sections.title: Check your starting point
sections.text: Gather statements and review contributions and charges. Make sure providers have current contact and beneficiary details.

sections.title: Plan your retirement budget
sections.text: Estimate future spending and compare it with projected income. Ask about contribution options and consider regulated advice for personal decisions.

PensionsProblems.title: Pension problems and changes
PensionsProblems.intro: Find records and work through pension concerns.

sections.title: Find missing information
sections.text: List former employers and search your records for scheme details. Use the GOV.UK Pension Tracing Service to locate contact information.

sections.title: Raise a concern
sections.text: Contact your provider with dates, documents and a clear explanation. Ask for its complaints procedure and keep copies of responses.

PensionTransfer.title: Pension transfers
PensionTransfer.intro: Compare what you could gain and what you could give up.

sections.title: Compare both schemes
sections.text: Ask about charges, guarantees, benefits and transfer terms before deciding. Combining pots is not always the right choice.

sections.title: Get appropriate advice
sections.text: Some transfers require regulated advice. Check requirements with your provider and be cautious of unsolicited transfer offers.

StatePension.title: State Pension
StatePension.intro: Check your forecast and plan alongside other retirement income.

sections.title: Check your forecast
sections.text: Use GOV.UK to view your State Pension forecast and State Pension age. Your entitlement depends on your individual record.

sections.title: Review your record
sections.text: Check your National Insurance history and ask about gaps. Confirm whether paying voluntary contributions would improve your pension before paying.

TakingPension.title: Taking your pension
TakingPension.intro: Explore how your pension could support retirement.

sections.title: Know your scheme
sections.text: Ask your provider about access rules and available options. Different pension types offer different ways to receive money.

sections.title: Plan before withdrawing
sections.text: Consider tax, ongoing income and how long your savings may need to last. Explore MoneyHelper and Pension Wise guidance before choosing.

TaxPension.title: Tax and pensions
TaxPension.intro: Understand the tax questions to ask about your pension.

sections.title: Contributions and relief
sections.text: Check how contributions and tax relief are handled by your scheme. Current limits depend on rules and your circumstances.

sections.title: Taking money out
sections.text: Withdrawals can affect taxable income. Check current HMRC guidance and ask your provider for an illustration before making a decision.

Taxandretirement.title: Tax and retirement
Taxandretirement.intro: Plan around the income you will actually receive.

sections.title: List your income sources
sections.text: Include pensions, work, savings and other expected income. Check how each is taxed using current GOV.UK guidance.

sections.title: Consider timing
sections.text: Taking a large withdrawal can change your tax position. Compare possible income patterns and seek qualified advice for complex decisions.
